record.question: ESCAP stands for
options: Economic and Social Commission for Asia and Pacific
European Society Council for Africa and Pacific
Economic and Social Commission for Africa and Pacific
record.explanation: Answer A: Economic and Social Commission for Asia and Pacific. The UN regional commission’s official name is “Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific.” Option (a) uniquely identifies the organization but omits the article “the”; recommend it with that visible minor wording note (option (a), zero-based index 0). Reference: https://www.unescap.org/commission/about-the-commission. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
